__broaden__.εἰδείη: οἶδα — know; perf. opt. 3 sg. (εἰδείη), in a relative clause of characteristic: ’might know’ · also perf. opt. 3 sg. in a condition after εἰ, with ἤπια: ’were to know kind things, were kindly disposed’ (εἴ μοι … ἤπια εἰδείη)
__broaden__.θάρσυνος: θάρσυνος — bold, confident, emboldened; adj., masc. nom. sg., with a dat. of cause: ’emboldened by’ · also fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with πόλις, with no dative: ’emboldened’
__broaden__.θήῃς: τίθημι — put, make; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., epic -ῃ- (= Attic θῇς), after μή in a clause of fear: ’lest you make (so-and-so)’ · also aor. subj. 2 sg. act. in a temporal clause after ἐπήν: ’once you have set’ (φάος ἐν νήεσσι θήῃς ’once you have set light among the ships’)
__broaden__.μήτέ: μήτε — and not, nor; correlative negative conj., μήτε … μήτε ’neither … nor’ with a command; accented before the enclitic τις · also correlative μήτε … μήτε with a wish (opt.) after αἲ γάρ: ’that no one … and no one’ (μήτέ τις … φύγοι)
__broaden__.πρόες: προΐημι — send forth, give up; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’give up!’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’send forth’ (ἐμέ … πρόες ’send me out’)
__broaden__.ἀμύνῃς: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα · also pres. subj. 2 sg. act. in a condition after αἴ κε μή: ’if you do not ward off’
__broaden__.ἀφίκηται: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid./dep., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until he reaches’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. mid./dep. in a temporal clause after ὁπότ’ ἂν: ’should reach’ (νῆας ἀφίκηται ’should reach the ships’)
__broaden__.ἐθέλῃσιν: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἐθέλῃ), after αἴ κεν · also pres. subj. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause, without κεν: ’does not wish’ · also pres. subj. 3 sg. in a temporal clause after ὁππότε δή, without κεν: ’whenever … wishes’
__broaden__.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται)
__broaden__.ὀπὸς: ὀπός — juice, sap (of the fig-tree, used to curdle milk); masc. nom. sg. · also ὄψ, ὀπός — voice; fem. gen. sg., with ἔκλυον: ’the voice (of the son of Atreus)’
__broaden__.ὁμοῖον: ὅμοιος — like, similar; neut. nom. sg., predicate (epic ὁμοῖος = Attic ὅμοιος): ’alike’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τινά, predicate of an infinitive: ’like (him)’ · also masc. acc. sg. after τόν (pronoun-form, ’that’), used as a noun: ’his equal’
__broaden__.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’)
__broaden__.ἄκτορος: Ἄκτωρ — Actor, father of Astyoche; masc. gen. sg. · also Actor, father of Menoetius and grandfather of Patroclus; masc. gen. sg.
__broaden__.ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης) · also epithet of Peleus: ’horseman’ (ἱππότα Πηλεύς)
__broaden__.ἰέναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf.: ’to go’ · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’go, return’ (ἐλάσας ἰέναι πάλιν ’having driven them off, go back’)
__broaden__.τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before an enclitic: ’a (man)’ · also masc. acc. sg. with a negative: ’no one’ (οὔ τινά φημι ’I say no one’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μῆτιν: ’some’ · also fem. acc. sg. standing alone for an understood θεοπροπίην: ’some (prophecy)’ (καί τινά τοι … ἐπέφραδε ’and has pointed out some to you’)
